_about: Payer provider-services hours for the simulated voice agent (Denial Intelligence, R3). DEMO DATA: these hours are UNVERIFIED-DEMO-ASSUMPTION, chosen so the demo shows both an open line (Anthem) and a closed line (Sentara closes at 3 pm) at the start of the story day (Thu Oct 29, 3:30 pm). Real hours must be read from the payer's provider manual or phone menu before anyone relies on them. No phone numbers are stored: a person dials the number on the payer's provider page. Times are the clinic's local time (Eastern); the demo clock is Eastern. The simulated call refuses to run while a line is closed (server and screen both).
